test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six friends Anshu, Aman, Adarsh, Akash, Arpit and Ankit are sitting in a row facing south. Arpit is sitting to the immediate right of Adarsh. Anshu is sitting fourth to the right of Arpit. Akash is sitting second to the left of Aman. Who is sitting second to the left of Anshu?
solution: Six friends Anshu, Aman, Adarsh, Akash, Arpit and Ankit are sitting in a row facing south. Arpit is sitting to the immediate right of Adarsh. Anshu is sitting fourth to the right of Arpit.
